subject: general
question: In November 2021, which state government released State Policy for Children 2021 to ensure prevention and protection of children from all forms of violence, abuse, and exploitation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Tamil Nadu** state government released the **State Policy for Children 2021 in November 2021.**
 
• This policy aims to ensure the prevention and protection of children from all forms of **violence, abuse, and exploitation.**
 
• It is a comprehensive framework designed to safeguard the rights and well-being of children in the state.
 
• The policy includes measures for **education, healthcare, and legal protection to create a safe and nurturing environment for children.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kerala**, **Punjab**, and **Rajasthan** were also considered, but the correct state implementing the policy in** November 2021 was Tamil Nadu.**
 
• The policy aligns with various national and international child rights conventions and laws, including the **United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child (**UNCRC**).**
 
• The **State Policy for Children 2021 **emphasizes the importance of community involvement and multi-stakeholder collaboration in protecting children's rights.
 
• It also focuses on addressing issues like child labor, trafficking, and discrimination against marginalized children.
